entities.name: severe stunting

entities.name: small grain and semidwarf phenotype
entities.description: Defective seed development phenotype reported for ossweet11 and ossweet14 mutants in rice.

entities.name: severe crumpling of the kernel
entities.description: Kernel phenotype caused by zmsweet4c mutation; associated with reduced yield.

relations.mechanism: Transcript abundance was significantly induced under salt stress and exogenous ABA; the gene was described as part of the set affected by multiple treatments.
relations.evidence: Under salt stress, the transcription of five ZmSWEET genes (ZmSWEET1a/4a/6a/6b/13a) was significantly induced... Under exogenous ABA treatment, the transcription of 16 ZmSWEET genes was induced, of which five genes (ZmSWEET1a/3b/12a/14a/15b) were significantly induced.

relations.mechanism: Transcript abundance was distinctly increased under Cd stress and significantly induced by exogenous ABA.
relations.evidence: Under Cd stress, the transcript abundance of ZmSWEET3b/11a/13b/17a was distinctly increased... Under exogenous ABA treatment, the transcription of 16 ZmSWEET genes was induced, of which five genes (ZmSWEET1a/3b/12a/14a/15b) were significantly induced.
